name: Just Jabba
role: Recording Artist / Event Curator / Creative Entrepreneur
bio:
Njabulo Mpanza, professionally known as Just Jabba, is a Johannesburg-born recording artist, creative entrepreneur, event curator, cultural strategist, and community builder dedicated to advancing South Africa’s creative economy. As the founder of Wav Impact and Verb Africa, he has built platforms that connect artists, creatives, and opportunities while championing the next generation of cultural leaders.

Known for blending hip-hop, Kwaito, jazz, and township storytelling, Just Jabba has spent nearly a decade crafting music that reflects both contemporary South African culture and global influences. Beyond his work as an artist, he is a respected event curator, project manager, tour manager, creative strategist, and ecosystem builder who has worked across artist development, live experiences, content production, and youth empowerment initiatives.

Holding an Honours Degree in International Relations from the University of the Witwatersrand, his work sits at the intersection of culture, leadership, entrepreneurship, and community development. Whether building platforms, curating stages, managing tours, or performing live, his mission remains the same: creating opportunities, strengthening creative communities, and ensuring African stories are seen, heard, and celebrated.
